QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired, and otherwise passes the result through unchanged.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and passes the tokenizer's `{}` failure result through unchanged. It also says "A real failure and legitimately empty input look the same to the caller", so failure and the unwired case give the same empty value.
